description: Claim -> Evidence Traceability Matrix for the FORGE EVOLVE for TMPC proposal and repository. Seeded in Phase 0; populated at proposal-write time (Phase 4). Every claim is A (anchored to a runnable artifact), E (external citation), or P (preliminary/surrogate, with a mandatory in-text label).

claims.claim_text: The repository contains no real TMPC source code or controlled data; the mission-planning component is synthetic and unclassified.
NAVAIR has publicly stated TMPC was designed in line with industry best practices of 25 to 40 years ago.
FORGE EVOLVE achieves ~99.4% module-level behavioral-equivalence pass rate on prior modernization benchmarks.
claims.label: Internal/preliminary prior art (COBOL/Fortran/Ada/VB6 -> Java/Python/Rust/TS); not government-validated; the C#/.NET capability is a newly developed extension.
